# Ali Baba Travel Advisor

> Ali Baba Travel Advisor is a visa consultancy and travel agency in Pakistan with offices in Lahore, Islamabad, Wazirabad and Karachi. It helps individuals, families and businesses with visa applications, visa refusal case review, group tours, tour packages, flights and hotels. Clients in every Pakistani city and province can start by phone, WhatsApp or online. Also written "AliBaba Travel Advisor". Website: https://alibabatraveladvisor.com/

Visa decisions are made only by embassies and immigration authorities. Ali Baba Travel Advisor prepares and reviews applications but never guarantees a visa. Requirements and fees change, so always confirm with the official embassy source.

## About

- Established 2024. Founder and CEO: Syed Ali Jawad, who has worked in this field since 2016.
- Registered with the SECP, associated with IATA, holds a DTS licence.
- Team: Operational Manager, Business Consultant, Visa Refusal Consultant, Sales Team Lead, Office Coordinator and Digital Marketing Manager (see the team page).
